children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Extend the Astro marketing site and MDX documentation while preserving navigation, canonical URLs, accessibility, and the Pencil source.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: The website is a separately versioned submodule; merge there first, then bump the gitlink in the main repository.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Astro pages, shared layouts/components, content collections, and the docs navigation module form the public-site contract.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Docs MDX lives in website/src/content/docs with a shared DocsLayout. Sidebar order comes from src/lib/docs-nav.ts.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Navigation, footer, canonical URLs, icons, and config are centralized.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Run the submodule locally, validate every static route, and check responsive, keyboard, contrast, metadata, and link behavior.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Install with npm ci and run the Astro development server.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Build before review to catch collection and route errors.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Test docs sidebar, previous/next, search states, mobile layouts, and 404.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Update Pencil first for visual changes, edit MDX and navigation together, merge the website repo, then bump and verify the submodule.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  cd website && npm ci && npm run dev

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  npm run build   # validate static routes and content

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Merge website PR → bump submodule pointer → verify public links

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
